in_marathi.name: Patralekha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of the Eyes
in_marathi.long_meaning: Patralekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Patralekha is derived from the Sanskrit words patra, meaning 'leaf' or 'letter' and lekha, meaning 'written' or 'described'. This name refers to the lady of the eyes, or the one who describes or writes with her eyes. In Hindu mythology, Patralekha is a character in the Mahabharata, who is known for her deep devotion and love for her husband, Arjuna.
